result:
My verdict is **PASS** for DG7 round 7, on candidate `sha256:0d71d4456adaac949e2c9af4c975f4b9976a166872195f496d5aa75fe8ed2272` (source `7579382c`, 3158 files). I checked the candidate ID in the repository and in a clone, at the start and again at the end. HEAD is one commit after the source commit. That commit is the freeze commit and changes only delivery records, which is how round 6 was handled too.

**The three round-6 findings (F-DG7-923, F-DG7-942, F-DG7-972) are CLOSED_VERIFIED.** ADR-0064 A5.6 requires three statements: a scheduled job that runs during the drill is explained only as A5.2 says and is listed in the report; a handler's business writes still fail D9, which is not a data defect; and the recovery is to re-run the drill, never to pause a schedule. All three now appear, in English and Arabic, in:
- `known-limitations.md`
- the release notes
- `deployment.md`
- both Arabic summaries

They match ADR-0064 A5.2 and A5.7 and the drill code, which only reads the schedule table and never writes it. The Arabic deployment summary leaves out one pg-boss sentence; the Arabic known-limitations summary has it, so I accepted that. The release notes regenerate identically with `--check`. In a throwaway clone, removing a statement, emptying the list, adding an unknown key or deleting the input file each made the check fail.

**The two new allow-list entries are safe.** Each hash matches a fragment of my own round-6 grep pattern, not a credential, and both apply to the history scan only.

**New finding, F-DG7-973 (Low, not mandatory, does not block the gate; owner solution-architect).** ADR-0071 §5 still says the release-notes generator "reads nothing else" and lists seven sections. It now reads `tools/release/release-notes-disclosures.json` and prints an extra section. D-280 accepts this instead of amending the ADR. The behaviour is sound; only the ADR text is out of date.

**Checks on the whole candidate:**

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | Pass. The first build failed only because my copy's dependency folder was read-only; the re-run passed. |
| `pnpm deps:verify` | Not run: it needs the live package registry (a known residual). I don't count it as a result. |
| Unit tests | 3042 + 2199 + 259 pass; 2 skipped by design |
| Integration tests | 5 failed in the first run, caused by my setup, not the product (below). The three affected files then passed 246/246. |
| Tool suites | 66 + 39 + 29 + 204, all pass |
| Release and licence tests | 469 of 471 pass; 2 skips explained |
| e2e, English and Arabic | 286 each; the one skip per language passed when run on its demo database (2/2) |
| Root acceptance specs | 288 pass, 18 explained skips; every connection stayed on loopback |
| Offline drill | 10/10; the Arabic screens are right-to-left and show "not set" rather than zero |
| A18 transfer drill | Two real drills on an archive built from this candidate, steps D0–D11 all pass; the A18 harness passes 10/10 |
| A19 backup and restore | Pass |
| Register, protocol audit, secret scans | Pass; the audit matches the frozen report |

- **Integration failures:** my linked dependency folder made `RenderError` load from two places, so an `instanceof` check failed. I also checked that the e2e servers ran the same compiled package code as a fresh build of the candidate.
- **A18 quarter-hour path:** neither drill window happened to include a scheduled-job slot, so the "schedule-explained" path didn't come up this round. It was verified on a real run in round 6, and the drill code hasn't changed since.
- **Container half:** there is no Docker daemon here, so I didn't re-run it and don't mark it as passed. The orchestrator's earlier host run still applies because no product or image input has changed.

The assignment points to `docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-7/qa-verifier.json` as the template, but that file doesn't exist, so I followed the schema and my round-6 record. Both records pass the gate schema validator.

No business, Finance or IT approval is granted or implied, and product gate G6 does not imply DG7.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG7/round-7/`:
- `qa-verifier.json`
- `qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- `qa-verifier.md`

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/qa/round-7/`.
